name: soleil-clusters-mcp
description: MCP server for Soleil Clusters — read and write visual boards from an AI assistant.
_mcpNameNote: mcpName is how the MCP Registry verifies that this package belongs to the server it claims to be. It MUST equal `name` in server.json, and the com.soleilpictures namespace is granted by a DNS TXT record on the apex of soleilpictures.com. Changing either without the other makes publishing fail.
